text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is the ability of machines to perform tasks that normally require human intelligence. This includes understanding language, recognizing patterns, and making decisions. A key part of AI is machine learning, where computers learn from data instead of being programmed with exact rules. For example, by analyzing thousands of photos, an AI can learn to identify cats. Deep learning is a more advanced type of machine learning that uses layers of artificial neural networks, similar to the human brain, to handle very complex problems. You encounter AI every day: in voice assistants like Siri, in recommendation systems on streaming services, and in navigation apps that suggest the fastest route.
